owns: Storefront live shipping rate quoting for classic WooCommerce checkout via the hp_shipstation WC shipping method (ShipStation-backed USPS/UPS rates, service allow-list with custom display names, carrier badges, quote caching)
must_not_own: cross-plugin source mutation without registered contract
ShipStation order export, tracking sync, or shipnotify handling (official woocommerce-shipstation-integration plugin plus HP-Core/HP-Inventory/HP-Checkout seams)
ShipStation credential storage (canonical store is HP-Core ShipStationSettings)
consumes: HP-Core shared ShipStation credentials via hp_ss_get_shipstation_credentials() -> HP_Core\Services\ShipStationSettings (option hp_core_shipstation_settings; fail-soft direct option fallback)

HP-Core central rating service via \HP_Core\get_service('shipstation_rates') / HP_Core\Services\ShipStationRatesService::getCarrierRates() (since 4.1.0; fail-soft inline ShipStation V1 HTTP fallback when the provider is absent or older)

providers: hp_ss_get_enabled_service_codes() - enabled ShipStation service codes for consumer plugins (e.g. HP-Core ShippingService allow-list, HP Funnel Bridge)
